Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3382); Jared (i.e. Jered), an antediluvian:--Jared.
BiblicalUsage: Jared is one of the long-lived fathers before the flood, and Luke names him in the genealogy of Jesus. In Luke 3:37 he stands between Enoch and Mahalaleel, a link in the line that runs from Adam to Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jared's place in the list is the point: the promise ran through men who lived and died long before it was kept, and God did not forget a single link.
